description: Fix the checkbox functionality in the linked row selection modal to ensure proper state management and visual feedback. When users select or deselect rows in the linked row modal, the checkboxes should accurately reflect the selection state and trigger appropriate data updates.
functional_requirements: Ensure checkboxes in the linked row modal correctly display selected/unselected states based on the underlying data
Implement proper event handling so checkbox clicks update the selection state and propagate changes to the parent component
Fix any visual inconsistencies where checkbox appearance doesn't match the actual selection state
Ensure the checkbox functionality works consistently across different view types (grid view, etc.) where linked row selection is used
